lesson: The scorer slate was too concentrated on forwards and omitted starting central midfielder Kevin Pina. The recurring tournament pattern is that midfield runners and deeper players take a substantial share of first goals, so at least one such starter should be retained even when five established attackers are available.

The institutional prior worked: Cuba's incumbent president was the likeliest official to announce the death of a senior revolutionary figure. Concentrating a majority on the current head of state while retaining Castro and the prime minister produced a strong score.

Updating promptly from the live leaderboard was decisive. Clark's four-shot opening-round advantage justified moving him from outside the slate to first at 22 percent, while keeping substantial field uncertainty because more than two rounds remained.

The facility inventory was incomplete and over-weighted Ras Laffan's best-known gas projects. Location questions about a specific industrial incident require enumerating smaller named plants and factories, including Barzan, before probabilities are concentrated.
Recent form and the prior Hungarian Grand Prix win correctly made Marc Marquez the favorite, while a broad five-rider slate preserved a useful positive score in a volatile motorsport market.
